overview: White plays 2.h3 preparing g4 against the Dutch f5 pawn, usually followed by Nf3 and e3 or g4 at once. Black replies with the usual Dutch set-ups, often ...Nf6 and ...e6, and the game is Dutch-like with a possible kingside pawn race. Details of the best handling are thin from memory.

white_ideas.idea: Prepare g4 to attack the f5 pawn
Nf3 and e3 with a flexible set-up

black_ideas.idea: Meet g4 with ...fxg4 hxg4 and ...Nxg4 ideas
Play ...d5 or ...d6 and a Dutch plan

typical_structures.structure: Dutch f5 pawn structure against h3/g4 advances

character.notes: A Dutch-type game with weakened kingsides and counterplay for both sides.

gambit.notes: No material is given on purpose in the main line.

structure.notes: Tension on the kingside, centre undecided.

approach.notes: A sidestep of main theory that strong players use occasionally.

sublines_that_differ.name: g4 push
sublines_that_differ.how: White offers a pawn on g4 for an attack.
